concepts.gloss_en: Shabbat, the Sabbath day (testifies to God's unity and creation; aspect of faith/truth)
'Bat' (daughter / pupil of the eye / prayer-blessings) — a distinct exegetical unit, not the day Shabbat

members.note: 'bat' = aspect of faith, bat-ayin (pupil of eye), or the prayer/blessings; even where linked to Shabbat it is one component ('shin-bat'), not identity with the day

notes: Mechanical signal treated בת as a clitic/truncation of שבת, but the proof quotes show they are separate concepts: שבת is the Sabbath day, while בת is an independent word/exegetical token (daughter, pupil of the eye, prayer). In lm1:57/lm2:83 בת appears as one letter-component within Shabbat ('shin-bat'), which is a part-of relation, not identity. Kept separate per under-merge rule.
